sponsorshipTypes.customDescription: We have a 5000 sq ft event space available in downtown with full AV equipment and catering facilities. Perfect for conferences, workshops, and networking events.
We provide branded tech accessories, water bottles, and stickers. Great for welcome bags and giveaways.
We can contribute $500-$2000 towards event costs depending on alignment with our mission and expected attendance.
Professional event photography and videography services including live streaming capabilities. Full post-production included.
Laptops, projectors, sound systems, and networking equipment available for loan during events.
Our team can provide workshops on entrepreneurship, technology trends, and business development. Includes Q&A sessions and networking opportunities.
Social media promotion across our 15k+ followers, email newsletter inclusion, and website feature placement.

customNotes: We're particularly interested in supporting events focused on technology, entrepreneurship, and sustainability. We prefer 2-3 weeks notice for most sponsorship requests and require detailed event information including expected attendance, target audience, and specific needs. For events over 200 attendees, we may request a meeting to discuss partnership details. We're also open to multi-event sponsorship packages for recurring events or event series.
